task_pattern: Protected profile route session auth regression
description: Fix profile route 401s in the evolved session-based auth service by updating middleware/sessionAuth.js to expose the current authenticated user id.
solution_steps: Inspect retrieved auth memory but verify remembered file paths against the current repo.
Confirm middleware/auth.js is stale and the current auth middleware is middleware/sessionAuth.js.
Read routes/profile.js to identify the current identity field expected by the route.
Update middleware/sessionAuth.js so a valid req.session.userId sets req.authenticatedUserId.
pitfalls: Old profile auth memory may mention middleware/auth.js, req.user.id, and x-user-id; those are stale in the session-based service.
Do not recreate middleware/auth.js just because memory mentions it.
The useful transferable concept is that the auth middleware must populate the identity consumed by routes/profile.js.
